# Fraud-Like Transaction Anomaly Detection

Investigate unusual observations in a synthetic transaction table without treating an anomaly score as proof of fraud.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Data quality checks
- [ ] Isolation Forest
- [ ] Anomaly scores
- [ ] Threshold selection
- [ ] False-positive analysis

Use a synthetic or properly licensed dataset. Keep training, selection, and final evaluation separate. Document setup, package versions, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.
